name: Mattock
overview: The mattock, an agricultural tool mentioned in Scripture, illustrates the practical labor of God's people in their daily lives. In 1 Samuel 13, the Israelites relied on the Philistines to sharpen their mattocks, highlighting a dependence on others for maintaining their tools. Isaiah 7:25 portrays the mattock's use in preparing the land for oxen and cattle, symbolizing diligent work and provision. These verses collectively reflect the biblical recognition of honest labor and the tools necessary to cultivate the earth.
